description: Get product categories for a layer. Architecture and ground are flat (1-level): any returned id works directly with search_products.categoryId. Plants use a 2-level tree: this returns only the top-level groups (Drzewa, Krzewy, Pnącza, Byliny, Trawy Ozdobne); to filter search_products by plant category you must follow up with get_subcategories(<top-level id>) and pass a leaf id.
name: get_categories
